entities.summary: Stella Chiweshe (b. 1946-07-08, Rhodesia) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Rhodesia and Zimbabwe. Known in the fields of zimbabwe, composers & musicians, africa.
